name: Sample: bank incident report and support tickets (fictional)

cases.prompt:
Summarise this incident report in 3 sentences for an executive.

INCIDENT REPORT - Harbour Ridge Credit Union (fictional)
Reference: INC-40721. Reported by: Priya Nambiar, Operations Manager.
On 14 March 2026 at 09:42, the card payment gateway at the Marina Street branch stopped responding after a scheduled certificate rotation. The outage lasted 3 hours 18 minutes. During that time 2,317 card transactions failed, with a total value of AED 486,250. No customer data was exposed. Root cause: the new certificate was installed on the primary node but not on the standby node, so failover did not work. The vendor, Kestrel Payments, restored service at 13:00. Corrective actions: add a certificate check to the release checklist (owner: Daniel Osei, due 30 April 2026) and run a failover test every quarter (owner: Mei Tan, due 15 May 2026). The central bank must be notified within 5 working days.

Extract these fields from the report and reply with JSON only, using the keys reference, date, failed_transactions, value, vendor.
